<definition>

Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.

reconciliation problem on the documents side [i:d93acbbda99a4ae5].\n- Brackwater Homecover reports a different failure mode, in auto-assignment rather than reconciliation [i:f65321d912d263c2].\n-
